source_evidence: Miscellaneous fees help to reimburse the broker for expenses incurred in performing the transaction or a service for you.
question: Misconception: Brokerage service charges are always just part of the trade commission, so there is no need to pay attention to them separately.
answer: Correction: Some brokers charge miscellaneous fees for expenses related to a transaction or service, in addition to a commission or markup. These fees may appear under different labels, so it is worth paying attention to them as well as to commissions.
